name: Karpura Gauram
text:
कर्पूरगौरं करुणावतारं संसारसारं भुजगेन्द्रहारम् ।
सदा वसन्तं हृदयारविन्दे भवं भवानीसहितं नमामि ॥
meaning: I bow to Shiva, radiant as camphor and compassionate, the essence of existence, adorned with the serpent, dwelling in the lotus of the heart together with Bhavani.
purpose: A devotional verse centred on compassion, presence and the relationship of Shiva and Bhavani.
when: As an opening or closing verse for meditation.
